Built on [*Forecasting: Principles and Practice, the Pythonic Way*](https://otexts.com/fpppy/)
(Hyndman, Athanasopoulos, Garza, Challu, Mergenthaler & Olivares), using the
`statsforecast` / `utilsforecast` stack.

Each day runs three hours as **five concept → exercise cycles**: a short segment, then you
do it while it is fresh.

## Before you start

- [Setup guide](labs/00_setup.md), install and verify, ~20 minutes
- [Pre-work notebook](labs/00_pre_work.ipynb), pandas dates, long format, an OLS refresher
- [Reference cheat sheet](labs/reference_cheatsheet.md), one page, printable

## Day 1: Structure

*Seeing what is actually in a series.*

| | |
|---|---|
| Segments 1–2 | [Getting Started & Time Series Patterns](slides/01_getting_started_and_patterns.html) |
| Segments 3–5 | [ACF, Decomposition & Features](slides/02_acf_decomposition_and_features.html) |
| Exercises | [`labs/01_day1_structure_and_diagnostics.ipynb`](labs/01_day1_structure_and_diagnostics.ipynb) |

Applications and what can be forecast · the three model families · trend, seasonality and
cycle · components · the golden rule · the four plots · autocorrelation and the
correlogram · Box-Cox and STL · features across a whole portfolio.

## Day 2: Toolbox & evaluation

*Forecasting, and proving whether the forecast was any good.*

| | |
|---|---|
| Segments 1–3 | [Benchmarks, Residuals & Prediction Intervals](slides/03_benchmarks_residuals_and_intervals.html) |
| Segments 4–5 | [Forecast Evaluation & Cross-Validation](slides/04_forecast_evaluation_and_cv.html) |
| Exercises | [`labs/02_day2_toolbox_and_evaluation.ipynb`](labs/02_day2_toolbox_and_evaluation.ipynb) |

The benchmark floor · fitted values and residuals · Ljung-Box · prediction intervals and
why they widen · MAE, RMSE, MAPE and why MASE instead · rolling-origin cross-validation ·
leakage.

Day 2 ends with an **evaluation harness** and the first rows of the course leaderboard.

## Day 3: Models

*In preparation.* The mix is still being decided: ETS, ARIMA, dynamic regression,
neural and foundation models. Whatever it turns out to be, every model gets plugged
into the harness built on Day 2 and added to the same leaderboard.
